text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see Cindy.
source_text: You see Cindy.

text: 你看见辛迪。
source_text: 你看见辛迪。

text: She is crying.
source_text: She is crying.

text: 她在哭。
source_text: 她在哭。

text: Hello,
source_text: Hello,

text: 你好，
source_text: 你好，

text: . Have you found the water chip yet?
source_text: . Have you found the water chip yet?

text: 。你找到净水芯片了？
source_text: 。你找到净水芯片了？

text: Not yet. I haven't had much luck.
source_text: Not yet. I haven't had much luck.

text: 还没。我运气不好。
source_text: 还没。我运气不好。

text: No luck yet, but I know I'll find it. By the way, how are you doing?
source_text: No luck yet, but I know I'll find it. By the way, how are you doing?

text: 没找到。我会找到的，你们怎么样了？
source_text: 没找到。我会找到的，你们怎么样了？

text: Urug!
source_text: Urug!

text: 喔！
source_text: 喔！

text: Oh . . . you don't understand me. I guess we really don't have much hope# after all. Excuse me while I cry.
source_text:
Oh . . . you don't understand me. I guess we really don't have much hope
# after all. Excuse me while I cry.

text: 哦……你没听明白，我想本来我们的机会就不大了。刚才我哭了，让你见笑了。
source_text: 哦……你没听明白，我想本来我们的机会就不大了。刚才我哭了，让你见笑了。

text: Ugg!
source_text: Ugg!

text: 吼吼！
source_text: 吼吼！

text: Please find it before we die of thirst.
source_text: Please find it before we die of thirst.

text: 赶紧找到它，我们会渴死的。
source_text: 赶紧找到它，我们会渴死的。

text: You've got to find it! Don't let us die like this!
source_text: You've got to find it! Don't let us die like this!

text: 你马上给我去找！别让我们这样死哇！
source_text: 你马上给我去找！别让我们这样死哇！

text: Keep trying. I believe in you. I know you will do everything you can# to save us.
source_text:
Keep trying. I believe in you. I know you will do everything you can
# to save us.

text: 继续吧，我信任你，我知道你会尽力的。
source_text: 继续吧，我信任你，我知道你会尽力的。

text: Who do you think might be involved?
source_text: Who do you think might be involved?

text: 谁跟这件事有关？
source_text: 谁跟这件事有关？

text: I am afraid of what is happening. Someone has been stealing water and now# everyone is on edge.
source_text:
I am afraid of what is happening. Someone has been stealing water and now
# everyone is on edge.

text: 最近的事情我好怕。有人在偷水，所有人现在都急得要死。
source_text: 最近的事情我好怕。有人在偷水，所有人现在都急得要死。

text: Who would do such a thing?
source_text: Who would do such a thing?

text: 谁会做这样的事？
source_text: 谁会做这样的事？

text: What happened?
source_text: What happened?

text: 发生什么了？
source_text: 发生什么了？

text: Some people have been accused and fights have broken out over it, but# nobody really knows.
source_text:
Some people have been accused and fights have broken out over it, but
# nobody really knows.

text: 有人互相指责，还有人大打出手，但没人知道谁是元凶。
source_text: 有人互相指责，还有人大打出手，但没人知道谁是元凶。

text: Okay. Thanks.
source_text: Okay. Thanks.

text: 好，多谢。
source_text: 好，多谢。

text: Some people reported that their water had been stolen. They weren't given# more water but some friends shared with them. After this everybody got very# paranoid and started guarding their water. A few days later someone knocked the# guard out in the ration supply area and stole water.
source_text:
Some people reported that their water had been stolen. They weren't given
# more water but some friends shared with them. After this everybody got very
# paranoid and started guarding their water. A few days later someone knocked the
# guard out in the ration supply area and stole water.

text: 有人报告说他们的水被偷了，上面的人说不能多发水，他们只能问朋友要水喝。这件事情后，所有人都疑神疑鬼的，把自己的水看得死死的。后来有一天，还有人把配给水站的守卫打晕了偷水！
source_text: 有人报告说他们的水被偷了，上面的人说不能多发水，他们只能问朋友要水喝。这件事情后，所有人都疑神疑鬼的，把自己的水看得死死的。后来有一天，还有人把配给水站的守卫打晕了偷水！

text: That's terrible! What can I do?
source_text: That's terrible! What can I do?

text: 太可怕了！我能做什么？
source_text: 太可怕了！我能做什么？

text: Maybe you can stop whoever is doing this.
source_text: Maybe you can stop whoever is doing this.

text: 你也许能帮我们找出这个人。
source_text: 你也许能帮我们找出这个人。

text: I'll take a look around.
source_text: I'll take a look around.

text: 我去看看。
source_text: 我去看看。

text: You're the water thief?! How could you?
source_text: You're the water thief?! How could you?

text: 你是偷水贼？怎么可能？
source_text: 你是偷水贼？怎么可能？

text: Thank you so much for saving us all.
source_text: Thank you so much for saving us all.

text: 谢谢你救了我们。
source_text: 谢谢你救了我们。

text: You did a good job catching the thief. Please hurry and find the water# chip.
source_text:
You did a good job catching the thief. Please hurry and find the water
# chip.

text: 你抓了偷水的人，做的好。那还是赶紧去找净水芯片吧。
source_text: 你抓了偷水的人，做的好。那还是赶紧去找净水芯片吧。

text: How could you betray us? Now everyone here will die! But you don't care,# do you?
source_text:
How could you betray us? Now everyone here will die! But you don't care,
# do you?

text: 你怎么能背叛我们呢？这里所有人都会渴死的！你不在乎，是不是？
source_text: 你怎么能背叛我们呢？这里所有人都会渴死的！你不在乎，是不是？

text: I'm scared. I don't know what will happen to us all. Please, don't let us# down.
source_text:
I'm scared. I don't know what will happen to us all. Please, don't let us
# down.

text: 我吓死了。我不知道以后还会发生什么。拜托，不要辜负我们。
source_text: 我吓死了。我不知道以后还会发生什么。拜托，不要辜负我们。

text: Don't worry, I'll do my best. You'll be all right.
source_text: Don't worry, I'll do my best. You'll be all right.

text: 别担心，我会尽力，你们不会有事的。
source_text: 别担心，我会尽力，你们不会有事的。

text: Yeah, whatever.
source_text: Yeah, whatever.

text: 对，随你说。
source_text: 对，随你说。
